addons.title: Dragon Riders
addons.author: AshenForge
addons.description: Tame, breed and ride dragons across the Overworld, with new mounts, armor and sky structures.
addons.content:
## Features

- Tame and breed **six dragon species**
- Craft saddles and armor
- Explore new sky structures

## Install

1. Download the `.mcaddon` file
2. Open it with Minecraft
3. Enable both packs in your world

> Bedrock needs experimental features turned on.

Support: [issue tracker](https://github.com)

addons.title: Create: Machines
addons.author: GearWright
addons.description: Build conveyor lines, drills and assembly machines to automate your base.
addons.content:
## What it adds

Conveyor belts, drills and assembly lines.

| Machine | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Drill | Mines ore automatically |
| Assembler | Crafts items from a recipe |

Requires **Java 21**.
